thread:
lina-pm: Avalon SI flagged an urgent blocking issue: marketplace image validation failing when pulling replicated images into GovCloud for their customer Pangea. Go/no-go for Tuesday if we don’t resolve. Need quick arch triage.
alex-se: Can you share the partner error logs?
lina-pm: Partner log: "AccessDenied: arn:aws:sts::222222222:assumed-role/marketplace-pull is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer". They also show "KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied" after initial layer handshake.
maya-eng: That combo screams cross-account ECR + KMS key policy. Also confirm they replicated to the correct Gov partition (aws-us-gov). Did partner accidentally replicate to commercial region?
sam-sre: Checking their egress. Partner said their CI runners are behind a firewall allowing only a handful of outbound ranges. If they hit commercial endpoints we won’t see traffic. @lina-pm can you confirm which endpoints their CI calls?
lina-pm: Partner claims `api.ecr.us-gov-west-1.amazonaws.com` but their CI template still references `amazonaws.com` in some places. Sending snippet and logs: https://s3.redwood.internal/pangea/avalon/replicate-log-3168123456.txt
zara-sec: If we adjust key policy to permit their role, we need a timeboxed exception + audit. I can approve scoped change for test but need org-owner in loop. Also need to ensure the KMS key is in GovCloud and not cross-partition.
alex-se: Quick repro plan: assume their `arn:aws-us-gov:iam::333333333:role/marketplace-pull` in our staging Gov account and attempt `docker pull`. Who can DM me the assume-role token?
partner-ops: DM sent to alex-se with short-lived creds and role ARN.
sam-sre: Running staging pull now. Result: `AccessDenied` for `GetDownloadUrlForLayer`. After granting granular ECR read to the partner role the pull advanced then failed on `kms:Decrypt`.
maya-eng: We can do two approaches: 1) temporary key-policy addition allowing the partner role `kms:Decrypt` on the image key (fast), or 2) re-encrypt replicated layers under a GovCloud KMS key we control and give the partner only pull rights (longer but safer).
zara-sec: I will approve option 1 for a 6-hour window with org-owner CC and automatic revert job, provided the IAM for the role is scoped to the specific repo ARNs. Filing security ticket SEC-5012.
alex-se: For minimal blast radius I scoped the ECR policy to the repo: ```json
{ "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchGetImage"], "Resource": "arn:aws-us-gov:ecr:us-gov-west-1:111111111:repository/marketplace/pangea-avalon" }
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued job 'avalon-replicate-staging' at 18:10 UTC -> https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/avalon-replicate-staging
partner-ops: After applying scoped ECR permissions + temporary KMS entry the partner reports validation passed in staging. They request a prod canary tonight.
sam-sre: I’ll run prod canary and have rollback steps ready (revoke key entry + block replica role).
zara-sec: Security follow-up: SEC-5012 created to 1) auto-revert key policy at T+6h, 2) add CloudTrail alert for cross-account Decrypt, 3) document GovCloud marketplace checklist.
lina-pm: Thanks team. Next steps: a) prod canary 22:00 UTC (sam-sre + alex-se), b) if canary green, run go-live Tuesday, c) schedule infra work to implement re-encrypt-on-replication for long-term (maya-eng). I'll DM partner the schedule and attach the checklist. Closing notes will be posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/partners/avalon-onboarding
alex-se: Can we also add a short how-to for SI partners about GovCloud partition pitfalls (endpoints, ARNs, KMS ownership)? I'll draft and drop into the Confluence page.
partner-ops: Partner confirms they have a contingency host AMI in GovCloud if canary fails. Appreciated the rapid turnaround.
lina-pm: Great. Will update this thread after the prod canary. :thumbsup:
